purpose: Constrain candidate NORAD 528 positions jointly by the past and future propagated positions of NORAD 527 and 529, at matching epochs; never assume fixed or observed separation.

source_dependencies.role: Secondary NORAD 528 mean-element state at 1963-10-27T14:40:16.132512Z, not original tracker readings
source_dependencies.uncertainty: Unknown original sensor epochs, error covariance, provenance and frame calibration
No independently certified terminal UTC, geolocation or observed reentry

source_dependencies.role: Printed period/inclination/apogee/perigee of 527 and 529, controls from one compiled family
source_dependencies.uncertainty: Publication date is not the epoch of each observation; common upstream tracking is possible

time_axis.qualification: Element-fit reference of secondary 528 mirror, not a timestamp of original measurement

state.frame: same calibrated Earth-centered inertial frame, otherwise reject model input
state.force_model: shared validated gravity/drag model with object-specific ballistic properties and propagated uncertainty
state.controls: 527 and 529 propagated at EXACTLY the candidate 528 epoch, including backwards or forwards when needed

constraints.role: negative control / detect model inconsistency without using 528 to fit the controls

constraints.predicate: for every axis j: |r528_j(t)-r527_j(t)| <= B527_j(t) AND |r528_j(t)-r529_j(t)| <= B529_j(t)
constraints.role: conservative overapproximation for certified distance/uncertainty bands

constraints.predicate: for every t in a declared past/future evaluation grid, all three pair bands and both coordinate envelopes hold
constraints.role: one disjoint certified 527/529 envelope on any axis excludes the full 528 candidate trajectory

requirements_before_activation: Authenticated tracking records or independently verified physical orbit elements for the relevant dates
Observation epochs, error ranges, covariance and frame transformations for each object
Consistent numerical propagator with drag, J2 and uncertainty budget for both time directions
Calibration/holdout against independent data, avoiding upstream shared-source double counting
Derived conservative separation intervals per common epoch, not guessed distances
output_intent: If calibrated sets exclude Conde and reported time for all candidate 528 trajectories, reject that branch; otherwise retain alternate branches and quantified uncertainty.
